rv.q: In Oh, Mary!, however, they have constructed a star vehicle for themselves, and it’s a work of deranged beauty: a version of Mary Todd Lincoln told (as the press release teases it) “through the lens of an idiot,” played with all the verve and severity of Bette Davis on bath salts.
The cast overall is terrific, with design elements that raise the production above anything you might expect.
This don’t-miss farce is a complete tour de force for the non-binary writer and actor Cole Escola, who is serving up 80 of the funniest minutes you’ll see in any medium!
In this master class of millennial mayhem, Escola slyly embraces multiple generations of queer comedy and storytelling.
Cole Escola’s “Oh, Mary!” is the funniest, most outrageous show I’ve seen this season.
Once seen, you won’t soon forget the chaos that happened in front of you.
a chance for Cole Escola to show off their immense talent to shock and, yes, entertain
